coverage: All four source sections in both English editions. These local texts omit the signatory lists; the actual individual references are George III and the religious invocations. Constitutional offices and institutions are not assigned to historical officeholders.

entities.name: George III
entities.body: The king of Great Britain against whom the Declaration directs its grievances.

entities.name: God
entities.body: The divine creator and judge invoked in the Declaration’s argument for independence.

entities.name: Jesus Christ
entities.body: The figure referred to by “our Lord” in the Constitution’s Christian dating formula.
